WreckItRalph_Scar/Scar_VLG_Ralp_010_VLG_.en: I-I mean, my plan to help the Valley. The Sunlit Plateau would be a far better place with more plant life, don't you think?
Specifically in the area just across from my den. You <Lore>plant and water</Lore>, I'll supervise.
I've got the Royal Tools for the job.
You want to beautify the area by your lair?
So... you want me to do all the work.
I knew I could count on you.
Go on now. <Lore>Plant and water new flowers on the Sunlit Plateau near my lair.</Lore>
I even got the seeds for you. Generous, I know.
As my second act of magnanimity, you must take some blooms to the Sea Witch. See? There I go, being generous again.
How else am I meant to keep an eye on the new plants?... And all the little creatures who might stop by to enjoy them...
I'm merely asking for you to show me how it's done.
